tableStatus.all:
WITH ingest AS (
    SELECT source_id, epoch AS source_epoch, checkpoint_lsn, lifecycle,
           CASE WHEN durable_through_epoch = epoch AND durable_through_lsn = checkpoint_lsn
                THEN epoch(durable_through_commit_ts) END AS durable_at_s,
           (SELECT (i ->> 'wal_status') FROM (SELECT unnest(from_json(coalesce(slots, '[]'), '["json"]')) AS i) WHERE (i ->> 'is_current')::BOOLEAN) AS wal_status
    FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_status" WHERE true
  ), flights AS (
    SELECT source_id,
           bool_or(flight IN ('ingest', 'apply') AND health IN ('failed', 'stale', 'deleted')) AS stopped,
           max(stale_after_s) FILTER (WHERE flight = 'apply') AS stale_after_s
    FROM (
  WITH ingest AS (
    SELECT s.source_id, 'ingest' AS flight, s.status_as_of / 1e6 AS last_s,
           CASE WHEN s.last_failure_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (s.status_as_of IS NULL OR epoch(s.last_failure_at) > s.status_as_of / 1e6)
                THEN 'failed' ELSE s.status END AS status,
           CASE WHEN s.last_failure_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (s.status_as_of IS NULL OR epoch(s.last_failure_at) > s.status_as_of / 1e6)
                THEN s.last_failure_error ELSE s.error END AS error,
           CASE WHEN s.last_failure_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (s.status_as_of IS NULL OR epoch(s.last_failure_at) > s.status_as_of / 1e6)
                THEN s.last_failure_step ELSE s.step END AS step,
           c.runs, c.gap_s, 600 AS floor_s,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_runs" r WHERE r.source_id = s.source_id AND r.status = 'conflict'
              AND r.written_at > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS conflicts_24h,
           s.last_conflict_at, s.last_success_as_of / 1e6 AS ok_s
    FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_status" s
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_id, count(*) AS runs, quantile_cont(gap, 0.75) AS gap_s FROM (
    SELECT source_id, as_of / 1e6 - lag(as_of / 1e6) OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY as_of / 1e6) AS gap,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY as_of / 1e6 DESC) AS k
    FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_runs" WHERE as_of / 1e6 IS NOT NULL) WHERE k <= 20 GROUP BY source_id) c USING (source_id)
    WHERE true
  ), apply_rows AS (
    SELECT source_id, epoch(written_at) AS t, status, error, step,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id, status = 'busy' ORDER BY written_at DESC) AS k
    FROM "ops"."main"."apply_runs" WHERE table_name IS NULL
  ), apply AS (
    SELECT n.source_id, 'apply' AS flight, n.t AS last_s, n.status, n.error, n.step,
           CASE WHEN b.t > n.t THEN b.t END AS busy_s, c.runs, c.gap_s, 1800 AS floor_s,
           (SELECT max(o.t) FROM apply_rows o WHERE o.source_id = a.source_id AND o.status IN ('done')) AS ok_s
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source_id FROM apply_rows) a
    LEFT JOIN apply_rows n ON n.source_id = a.source_id AND n.status <> 'busy' AND n.k = 1
    LEFT JOIN apply_rows b ON b.source_id = a.source_id AND b.status = 'busy' AND b.k = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_id, count(*) AS runs, quantile_cont(gap, 0.75) AS gap_s FROM (
    SELECT source_id, epoch(written_at) - lag(epoch(written_at)) OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY epoch(written_at)) AS gap,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY epoch(written_at) DESC) AS k
    FROM "ops"."main"."apply_runs" WHERE epoch(written_at) IS NOT NULL AND table_name IS NULL AND status <> 'busy') WHERE k <= 20 GROUP BY source_id) c ON c.source_id = a.source_id
  ), backfill AS (
    SELECT source_id, 'backfill' AS flight, epoch(written_at) AS last_s, status, error, step,
           NULL::BIGINT AS runs, NULL::DOUBLE AS gap_s, NULL::INTEGER AS floor_s
    FROM "ops"."main"."backfill_runs" WHERE true
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY written_at DESC) = 1
  ), compaction AS (
    SELECT source_id, 'compaction' AS flight, run_as_of / 1e6 AS last_s, status, error, NULL AS step,
           NULL::BIGINT AS runs, NULL::DOUBLE AS gap_s, 93600 AS floor_s
    FROM "ops"."main"."compaction_status" WHERE true
  ), every AS (
    SELECT * FROM ingest UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT * FROM apply
    UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT * FROM backfill UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT * FROM compaction
  ), own AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN floor_s IS NULL THEN NULL
                   WHEN coalesce(runs, 0) < 5 THEN floor_s
                   ELSE greatest(floor_s, round(2 * gap_s)) END AS own_after_s,
           CASE WHEN flight NOT IN ('ingest', 'apply') THEN NULL
                WHEN coalesce(runs, 0) < 5 THEN 3600
                ELSE greatest(3600, round(6 * gap_s)) END AS own_urgent_s
    FROM every
  ), limits AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN flight = 'apply'
                   THEN greatest(own_after_s, max(CASE WHEN flight = 'ingest' THEN own_after_s END)
                                              OVER (PARTITION BY source_id))
                   ELSE own_after_s END AS after_s,
           CASE WHEN flight = 'apply'
                THEN greatest(own_urgent_s, max(CASE WHEN flight = 'ingest' THEN own_urgent_s END)
                                            OVER (PARTITION BY source_id))
                ELSE own_urgent_s END AS urgent_after_s
    FROM own
  )
  SELECT source_id, flight, status, error, step,
         strftime((to_timestamp(last_s)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC') AS last_run_at, strftime((to_timestamp(busy_s)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC') AS busy_since,
         conflicts_24h, strftime((last_conflict_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC') AS last_conflict_at,
         round(epoch(current_timestamp) - last_s) AS age_s,
         after_s AS stale_after_s,
         CASE WHEN error = 'SourceDeleted' THEN 'deleted'
              WHEN status IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN last_s IS NULL THEN 'no_runs' ELSE 'unknown' END
              WHEN CASE WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'drained' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'capped' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'busy' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'conflict' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN flight = 'apply' AND status = 'done' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'apply' AND status = 'needs_operator' THEN 'attention' WHEN flight = 'apply' AND status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'published' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'idle' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'snapshotting' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'catching_up' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_for_ingest' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_for_marker' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'busy' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'busy_publish' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'done' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'abandoned' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_for_replay' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_past_replay' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_for_primary' THEN 'attention' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'done' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'capped' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'busy' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'held' THEN 'attention' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'invariant' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'unknown' END <> 'ok' THEN CASE WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'drained' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'capped' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'busy' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'conflict' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'ingest' AND status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN flight = 'apply' AND status = 'done' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'apply' AND status = 'needs_operator' THEN 'attention' WHEN flight = 'apply' AND status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'published' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'idle' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'snapshotting' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'catching_up' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_for_ingest' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_for_marker' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'busy' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'busy_publish' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'done' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'abandoned' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_for_replay' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_past_replay' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'backfill' AND status = 'waiting_for_primary' THEN 'attention' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'done' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'capped' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'busy' THEN 'ok' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'held' THEN 'attention' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN flight = 'compaction' AND status = 'invariant' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'unknown' END
              WHEN after_s IS NOT NULL AND (last_s IS NULL OR epoch(current_timestamp) - last_s > after_s)
                   THEN 'stale'
              WHEN coalesce(conflicts_24h, 0) >= 2 THEN 'attention'
              ELSE 'ok' END AS health,
         coalesce(ok_s, last_s) AS ok_at_s, urgent_after_s,
         coalesce(health = 'stale' AND epoch(current_timestamp) - coalesce(ok_s, last_s) > urgent_after_s, false) AS urgent
  FROM limits ORDER BY source_id, flight) GROUP BY source_id
  ), apply AS (
    SELECT source_id, relation_id, schema_name || '.' || table_name AS table_name, state, detail,
           epoch, applied_lsn, generation_id, held_since, blocked_commit_lsn, blocked_unit_start_lsn, blocked_unit_end_lsn,
           pin_lsn, pin_updated_at, coalesce(quarantine_count, 0) AS quarantines,
           capture_mode, ignore_deletes,
           deletes_ignored, last_truncate_lsn,
           coalesce(hold_code, CASE
      WHEN regexp_matches(detail, '^append_update: ') THEN 'append_update'
      WHEN regexp_matches(detail, '^append_delete: ') THEN 'append_delete'
      WHEN regexp_matches(detail, '^column .* changed type') THEN 'type_changed'
      WHEN detail = 'the source table''s primary key constraint was replaced; resync' THEN 'pk_replaced'
      WHEN detail = 'a partition of the source table was attached or detached; resync' THEN 'partitions_changed'
      WHEN detail = 'a column was added with a default its existing rows read without WAL; resync' THEN 'column_default_fill'
      WHEN detail = 'a column was added while the source table was rewritten; resync' THEN 'column_rewrite'
      WHEN detail = 'a partition of the source table was attached or detached; start-from-log (it drops the rows before the new start)' THEN 'partitions_changed'
    END) AS reason,
           CASE WHEN applied_through_epoch = epoch AND applied_through_lsn = applied_lsn
                THEN epoch(applied_through_commit_ts) END AS updated_at_s
    FROM "ops"."main"."apply_status" a WHERE true
      -- apply_status is an upsert that never deletes: a not_started row older than the
      -- source's newest full snapshot (the as_of of its newest run row's run) is stale
      AND NOT coalesce(state = 'not_started' AND as_of < (
        SELECT max(s.as_of) FROM "ops"."main"."apply_status" s
        WHERE s.source_id = a.source_id AND s.run_id = (
          SELECT arg_max(r.run_id, r.written_at) FROM "ops"."main"."apply_runs" r
          WHERE r.source_id = a.source_id AND r.table_name IS NULL)), false)
  ), holds AS (
    SELECT source_id, table_name, arg_min(reason, k) AS reason, arg_min(detail, k) AS detail,
           min(held_since) AS held_since
    FROM (SELECT source_id, (i ->> 'table') AS table_name, (i ->> 'reason') AS reason, (i ->> 'detail') AS detail,
                 (i ->> 'held_since')::TIMESTAMPTZ AS held_since,
                 CASE (i ->> 'reason') WHEN 'removed' THEN 2 WHEN 'unmanaged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS k
          FROM (SELECT source_id, unnest(from_json(coalesce(holds, '[]'), '["json"]')) AS i FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_status" WHERE true)
          WHERE (i ->> 'reason') <> 'key_change_pending')
    GROUP BY ALL
  ), gen AS (
    SELECT source_id, table_name, generation_id, state AS gen_state, mode AS gen_mode, pin_lsn AS gen_pin_lsn,
           chunks, chunks_total, created_at
    FROM "ops"."main"."backfill_status" WHERE true
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id, table_name ORDER BY created_at DESC) = 1
  ), gen_run AS (
    -- a generation's failure reason is in detail (error names a crashed run's exception)
    SELECT source_id, generation_id, coalesce(detail, error) AS gen_error, written_at AS gen_run_at,
           status AS gen_run_status
    FROM "ops"."main"."backfill_runs" WHERE true
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id, generation_id ORDER BY written_at DESC) = 1
  ), kept AS (
    -- the generation an insert-only table's newest re-snapshot or start-from-log replaced:
    -- its mirror is kept aside as <table>__gen_<its first 8 hex> (append_apply._keep_mirror)
    SELECT source_id, table_name, generation_id AS kept_generation
    FROM "ops"."main"."backfill_status" WHERE state = 'replaced'
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id, table_name ORDER BY coalesce(updated_at, created_at) DESC) = 1
  ), refusal AS (
    -- the table's newest refused backfill start (no generation): over the snapshot limit,
    -- or waiting for ingest to pass a catalog hold
    SELECT source_id, table_name, detail AS refused_detail, written_at AS refused_at
    FROM "ops"."main"."backfill_runs" WHERE status = 'refused' AND table_name IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id, table_name ORDER BY written_at DESC) = 1
  ), awaiting AS (
    -- an insert-only table registered with no mirror generation yet (apply_run)
    SELECT source_id, table_name, max(written_at) AS awaiting_at
    FROM "ops"."main"."apply_runs" WHERE status = 'awaiting_generation' AND table_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ALL
  ), pin AS (
    SELECT source_id, (i ->> 'relation_id')::UINTEGER AS relation_id, (i ->> 'expires_at_us')::BIGINT AS expires_at_us
    FROM (SELECT source_id, unnest(from_json(coalesce(pins, '[]'), '["json"]')) AS i FROM "ops"."main"."compaction_status" WHERE true)
    WHERE (i ->> 'kind') = 'table'
  ), acts AS (
    SELECT source_id, action, inputs ->> 'table' AS table_name, written_at,
           coalesce(started_by, token_user) AS actor
    FROM "ops"."main"."audit"
    WHERE NOT dry_run AND (result ->> 'status') = 'done'
      AND action IN ('pause', 'resync', 'add', 'resync-all', 'recover-slot')
  ), applied AS (
    SELECT source_id, table_name,
           sum(events) FILTER (WHERE written_at > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS changes
    FROM "ops"."main"."apply_runs" WHERE table_name IS NOT NULL AND events > 0 GROUP BY ALL
  ), every AS (
    SELECT source_id, table_name FROM apply UNION SELECT source_id, table_name FROM holds
    UNION SELECT source_id, table_name FROM gen WHERE gen_state IN ('snapshotting', 'catching_up', 'failed')
    UNION SELECT source_id, table_name FROM awaiting
  ), joined AS (
    SELECT e.source_id, e.table_name, a.relation_id, a.state, a.detail AS apply_detail, a.epoch, i.source_epoch,
           a.applied_lsn, a.generation_id, a.held_since, a.blocked_commit_lsn, a.blocked_unit_start_lsn, a.blocked_unit_end_lsn,
           a.pin_lsn, a.pin_updated_at, coalesce(a.quarantines, 0) AS quarantines, a.updated_at_s,
           -- a registry hold: ingest's holds list, else apply's registry code
           coalesce(h.reason, CASE WHEN a.reason IN ('append_keyed_frames', 'append_identity', 'append_partitioned', 'removed', 'unmanaged', 'dropped', 'renamed', 'replaced', 'unpublished', 'invalid_kind', 'no_select', 'no_key', 'identity_not_full', 'leaf_invalid', 'publication_filter') AND a.reason <> 'append_keyed_frames' THEN a.reason END) AS hold_reason,
           coalesce(h.detail, CASE WHEN a.reason IN ('append_keyed_frames', 'append_identity', 'append_partitioned', 'removed', 'unmanaged', 'dropped', 'renamed', 'replaced', 'unpublished', 'invalid_kind', 'no_select', 'no_key', 'identity_not_full', 'leaf_invalid', 'publication_filter') THEN a.detail END) AS hold_detail,
           coalesce(h.held_since, CASE WHEN a.reason IN ('append_keyed_frames', 'append_identity', 'append_partitioned', 'removed', 'unmanaged', 'dropped', 'renamed', 'replaced', 'unpublished', 'invalid_kind', 'no_select', 'no_key', 'identity_not_full', 'leaf_invalid', 'publication_filter') THEN a.held_since END) AS hold_since,
           g.generation_id AS gen_id, g.gen_state, g.chunks, g.chunks_total, g.created_at AS gen_created_at,
           gr.gen_error, gr.gen_run_at, gr.gen_run_status, p.expires_at_us,
           a.capture_mode, a.ignore_deletes, a.deletes_ignored, a.last_truncate_lsn, a.reason,
           CASE WHEN g.gen_mode = 'log_incomplete' AND g.gen_state = 'published' AND g.generation_id = a.generation_id
                THEN g.gen_pin_lsn END AS log_start_lsn,
           CASE WHEN a.capture_mode = 'append' AND k.kept_generation IS NOT NULL
                THEN e.table_name || '__gen_' || left(k.kept_generation, 8) END AS kept_aside,
           -- a refusal newer than the table's newest generation: the resync (or first
           -- snapshot) didn't start
           CASE WHEN rf.refused_at > coalesce(g.created_at, '-infinity'::TIMESTAMPTZ) THEN rf.refused_detail END AS refused_detail,
           aw.awaiting_at IS NOT NULL AS awaiting,
           (a.epoch = i.source_epoch AND a.applied_lsn >= i.checkpoint_lsn) AS caught_up,
           i.durable_at_s, i.checkpoint_lsn,
           coalesce(fl.stopped, false) OR i.wal_status IN ('lost', 'missing') OR i.lifecycle IS NOT NULL AS stopped,
           fl.stale_after_s, coalesce(ap.changes, 0) AS changes_7d
    FROM every e
    LEFT JOIN apply a USING (source_id, table_name) LEFT JOIN holds h USING (source_id, table_name)
    LEFT JOIN gen g USING (source_id, table_name)
    LEFT JOIN gen_run gr ON gr.source_id = g.source_id AND gr.generation_id = g.generation_id
    LEFT JOIN pin p ON p.source_id = e.source_id AND p.relation_id = a.relation_id
    LEFT JOIN ingest i ON i.source_id = e.source_id LEFT JOIN flights fl ON fl.source_id = e.source_id
    LEFT JOIN applied ap ON ap.source_id = e.source_id AND ap.table_name = e.table_name
    LEFT JOIN kept k ON k.source_id = e.source_id AND k.table_name = e.table_name
    LEFT JOIN refusal rf ON rf.source_id = e.source_id AND rf.table_name = e.table_name
    LEFT JOIN awaiting aw ON aw.source_id = e.source_id AND aw.table_name = e.table_name
  ), judged AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN caught_up THEN 0 WHEN durable_at_s IS NOT NULL AND updated_at_s IS NOT NULL
                THEN greatest(0, durable_at_s - updated_at_s) END AS behind_s,
           gen_state IN ('snapshotting', 'catching_up') AS rebuilding,
           (expires_at_us / 1e6) - epoch(current_timestamp) AS expires_in_s
    FROM joined
  ), classed AS (
    SELECT *,
      CASE WHEN hold_reason = 'removed' THEN 'removed'
           WHEN hold_reason = 'unmanaged' THEN 'not_enabled'
           WHEN hold_reason IN ('append_identity', 'append_partitioned') OR reason = 'append_keyed_frames' THEN 'append_invalid'
           WHEN hold_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'registry'
           -- a held table's resync runs beside its held mirror (keyed, or an insert-only
           -- re-snapshot): it reads Rebuilding until it publishes, or Needs action again if it fails
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' AND rebuilding THEN 'rebuilding'
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' AND reason IN ('append_update', 'append_delete') THEN 'append_changed'
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' AND reason = 'type_changed' THEN 'type_changed'
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' AND reason IN ('pk_replaced', 'partitions_changed', 'column_default_fill', 'column_rewrite') THEN 'catalog_changed'
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' THEN 'blocked'
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' AND rebuilding THEN 'rebuilding'
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' AND gen_state = 'failed' THEN 'rebuild_failed'
           -- resync-all skips insert-only tables (re-snapshots are per table): never queued
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' AND epoch < source_epoch AND capture_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'append' THEN 'queued'
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' AND reason IN ('pk_replaced', 'partitions_changed', 'column_default_fill', 'column_rewrite') THEN 'catalog_changed'
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' THEN 'needs_resync'
           WHEN rebuilding THEN 'rebuilding'
           -- no mirror yet: a not_started row (hold_code), or an older writer's
           -- awaiting_generation run row; a running first backfill reads rebuilding above
           WHEN coalesce(state, 'not_started') = 'not_started' AND gen_state = 'failed' THEN 'rebuild_failed'
           WHEN state = 'not_started' OR (state IS NULL AND (awaiting OR refused_detail IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'not_started'
           WHEN state = 'paused' THEN 'paused'
           WHEN state IS NULL OR state <> 'live' THEN 'unknown'
           WHEN stopped THEN 'waiting'
           WHEN behind_s > 86400 THEN 'stale'
           WHEN behind_s > stale_after_s THEN 'stale'
           ELSE 'ok' END AS kind
    FROM judged
  )
  SELECT c.source_id, c.table_name, c.relation_id,
         CASE WHEN kind IN ('registry', 'blocked', 'rebuild_failed', 'needs_resync', 'append_changed', 'catalog_changed',
                           'type_changed', 'append_invalid', 'not_started') THEN 'needs_action'
              WHEN kind = 'paused' AND expires_in_s < 86400 THEN 'needs_action'
              WHEN kind = 'stale' AND behind_s > 86400 THEN 'needs_action'
              ELSE kind END AS status,
         kind, c.state,
         CASE kind WHEN 'registry' THEN hold_reason || coalesce(': ' || hold_detail, '')
                   WHEN 'append_invalid' THEN hold_detail
                   WHEN 'not_started' THEN refused_detail
                   WHEN 'rebuild_failed' THEN gen_error ELSE apply_detail END AS detail,
         round(behind_s) AS behind_s, round(expires_in_s) AS expires_in_s, expires_at_us / 1e6 AS expires_at_s,
         CASE WHEN kind IN ('rebuilding') THEN epoch(c.gen_created_at)
              WHEN kind = 'rebuild_failed' THEN epoch(gen_run_at)
              WHEN kind IN ('registry', 'not_enabled', 'removed', 'append_invalid') THEN epoch(hold_since)
              ELSE epoch(c.held_since) END AS since_at_s,
         round(epoch(current_timestamp) - epoch(c.held_since)) AS held_for_s,
         x.actor, x.action AS actor_action,
         c.chunks, c.chunks_total, c.gen_id AS generation_id, c.gen_state, c.gen_run_status,
         c.updated_at_s, c.durable_at_s, c.epoch, c.source_epoch,
         CASE WHEN c.applied_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.applied_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.applied_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS applied_lsn, CASE WHEN c.checkpoint_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.checkpoint_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.checkpoint_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS checkpoint_lsn,
         CASE WHEN c.blocked_commit_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.blocked_commit_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.blocked_commit_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS blocked_commit_lsn,
         CASE WHEN c.blocked_unit_start_lsn IS NOT NULL
              THEN CASE WHEN c.blocked_unit_start_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.blocked_unit_start_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.blocked_unit_start_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END || '..' || CASE WHEN c.blocked_unit_end_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.blocked_unit_end_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.blocked_unit_end_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END END AS blocked_unit,
         CASE WHEN c.pin_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.pin_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.pin_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS pin_lsn, epoch(c.pin_updated_at) AS pin_moved_at_s,
         c.quarantines, c.changes_7d,

    LEFT JOIN apply a USING (source_id, table_name) LEFT JOIN holds h USING (source_id, table_name)
    LEFT JOIN gen g USING (source_id, table_name)
    LEFT JOIN gen_run gr ON gr.source_id = g.source_id AND gr.generation_id = g.generation_id
    LEFT JOIN pin p ON p.source_id = e.source_id AND p.relation_id = a.relation_id
    LEFT JOIN ingest i ON i.source_id = e.source_id LEFT JOIN flights fl ON fl.source_id = e.source_id
    LEFT JOIN applied ap ON ap.source_id = e.source_id AND ap.table_name = e.table_name
    LEFT JOIN kept k ON k.source_id = e.source_id AND k.table_name = e.table_name
    LEFT JOIN refusal rf ON rf.source_id = e.source_id AND rf.table_name = e.table_name
    LEFT JOIN awaiting aw ON aw.source_id = e.source_id AND aw.table_name = e.table_name
  ), judged AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN caught_up THEN 0 WHEN durable_at_s IS NOT NULL AND updated_at_s IS NOT NULL
                THEN greatest(0, durable_at_s - updated_at_s) END AS behind_s,
           gen_state IN ('snapshotting', 'catching_up') AS rebuilding,
           (expires_at_us / 1e6) - epoch(current_timestamp) AS expires_in_s
    FROM joined
  ), classed AS (
    SELECT *,
      CASE WHEN hold_reason = 'removed' THEN 'removed'
           WHEN hold_reason = 'unmanaged' THEN 'not_enabled'
           WHEN hold_reason IN ('append_identity', 'append_partitioned') OR reason = 'append_keyed_frames' THEN 'append_invalid'
           WHEN hold_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'registry'
           -- a held table's resync runs beside its held mirror (keyed, or an insert-only
           -- re-snapshot): it reads Rebuilding until it publishes, or Needs action again if it fails
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' AND rebuilding THEN 'rebuilding'
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' AND reason IN ('append_update', 'append_delete') THEN 'append_changed'
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' AND reason = 'type_changed' THEN 'type_changed'
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' AND reason IN ('pk_replaced', 'partitions_changed', 'column_default_fill', 'column_rewrite') THEN 'catalog_changed'
           WHEN state = 'needs_action' THEN 'blocked'
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' AND rebuilding THEN 'rebuilding'
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' AND gen_state = 'failed' THEN 'rebuild_failed'
           -- resync-all skips insert-only tables (re-snapshots are per table): never queued
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' AND epoch < source_epoch AND capture_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'append' THEN 'queued'
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' AND reason IN ('pk_replaced', 'partitions_changed', 'column_default_fill', 'column_rewrite') THEN 'catalog_changed'
           WHEN state = 'needs_resync' THEN 'needs_resync'
           WHEN rebuilding THEN 'rebuilding'
           -- no mirror yet: a not_started row (hold_code), or an older writer's
           -- awaiting_generation run row; a running first backfill reads rebuilding above
           WHEN coalesce(state, 'not_started') = 'not_started' AND gen_state = 'failed' THEN 'rebuild_failed'
           WHEN state = 'not_started' OR (state IS NULL AND (awaiting OR refused_detail IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'not_started'
           WHEN state = 'paused' THEN 'paused'
           WHEN state IS NULL OR state <> 'live' THEN 'unknown'
           WHEN stopped THEN 'waiting'
           WHEN behind_s > 86400 THEN 'stale'
           WHEN behind_s > stale_after_s THEN 'stale'
           ELSE 'ok' END AS kind
    FROM judged
  )
  SELECT c.source_id, c.table_name, c.relation_id,
         CASE WHEN kind IN ('registry', 'blocked', 'rebuild_failed', 'needs_resync', 'append_changed', 'catalog_changed',
                           'type_changed', 'append_invalid', 'not_started') THEN 'needs_action'
              WHEN kind = 'paused' AND expires_in_s < 86400 THEN 'needs_action'
              WHEN kind = 'stale' AND behind_s > 86400 THEN 'needs_action'
              ELSE kind END AS status,
         kind, c.state,
         CASE kind WHEN 'registry' THEN hold_reason || coalesce(': ' || hold_detail, '')
                   WHEN 'append_invalid' THEN hold_detail
                   WHEN 'not_started' THEN refused_detail
                   WHEN 'rebuild_failed' THEN gen_error ELSE apply_detail END AS detail,
         round(behind_s) AS behind_s, round(expires_in_s) AS expires_in_s, expires_at_us / 1e6 AS expires_at_s,
         CASE WHEN kind IN ('rebuilding') THEN epoch(c.gen_created_at)
              WHEN kind = 'rebuild_failed' THEN epoch(gen_run_at)
              WHEN kind IN ('registry', 'not_enabled', 'removed', 'append_invalid') THEN epoch(hold_since)
              ELSE epoch(c.held_since) END AS since_at_s,
         round(epoch(current_timestamp) - epoch(c.held_since)) AS held_for_s,
         x.actor, x.action AS actor_action,
         c.chunks, c.chunks_total, c.gen_id AS generation_id, c.gen_state, c.gen_run_status,
         c.updated_at_s, c.durable_at_s, c.epoch, c.source_epoch,
         CASE WHEN c.applied_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.applied_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.applied_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS applied_lsn, CASE WHEN c.checkpoint_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.checkpoint_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.checkpoint_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS checkpoint_lsn,
         CASE WHEN c.blocked_commit_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.blocked_commit_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.blocked_commit_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS blocked_commit_lsn,
         CASE WHEN c.blocked_unit_start_lsn IS NOT NULL
              THEN CASE WHEN c.blocked_unit_start_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.blocked_unit_start_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.blocked_unit_start_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END || '..' || CASE WHEN c.blocked_unit_end_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.blocked_unit_end_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.blocked_unit_end_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END END AS blocked_unit,
         CASE WHEN c.pin_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.pin_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.pin_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS pin_lsn, epoch(c.pin_updated_at) AS pin_moved_at_s,
         c.quarantines, c.changes_7d,
         c.reason, c.capture_mode, c.ignore_deletes, c.deletes_ignored, CASE WHEN c.last_truncate_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.last_truncate_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.last_truncate_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS last_truncate_lsn,
         CASE WHEN c.log_start_lsn IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE format('{:X}/{:X}', (c.log_start_lsn)::UBIGINT >> 32, (c.log_start_lsn)::UBIGINT & 4294967295) END AS log_start_lsn, c.kept_aside,
         -- a failed rebuild beside a live mirror (any state but rebuild_failed's own)
         CASE WHEN c.gen_state = 'failed' AND kind <> 'rebuild_failed' AND c.gen_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.generation_id
              THEN c.gen_error END AS rebuild_error,
         CASE WHEN kind <> 'not_started' THEN c.refused_detail END AS refused_detail,
         contains(coalesce(c.refused_detail, ''), 'ingest has not yet passed the source key change') AS waits_for_ingest
  FROM classed c
  -- who started it: the newest real run of the matching action before it began
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT actor, action FROM acts
    WHERE acts.source_id = c.source_id
      AND ((c.kind = 'paused' AND action = 'pause' AND acts.table_name = c.table_name
            AND written_at <= c.held_since + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)
        OR (c.kind = 'rebuilding' AND written_at <= c.gen_created_at + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE
            AND written_at >= c.gen_created_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND (action IN ('resync-all', 'recover-slot') OR (action IN ('resync', 'add') AND acts.table_name = c.table_name))))
    ORDER BY written_at DESC LIMIT 1) x ON true
  ORDER BY c.source_id, c.table_name

    UNION SELECT DISTINCT source_id, table_name FROM per_table
  ), marks AS (
    SELECT t.source_id, t.table_name, m.i, now_k.k - 27 + m.i AS k
    FROM tables t, now_k, range(28) m(i)
  )
  SELECT m.source_id, m.table_name,
         string_agg(CASE WHEN coalesce(p.failed, 0) + coalesce(r.failed, 0) = 0
                         THEN CASE WHEN coalesce(p.ok, 0) > 0 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'none' END
                         WHEN coalesce(p.ok, 0) > 0 THEN 'some' ELSE 'failed' END, ',' ORDER BY m.i) AS marks
  FROM marks m

  LEFT JOIN per_run r ON r.source_id = m.source_id AND r.k = m.k
  GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY m.source_id, m.table_name

WITH slot AS (
    SELECT source_id, slots_as_of, (i ->> 'name') AS slot_name, (i ->> 'wal_status') AS wal_status,
           (i ->> 'active')::BOOLEAN AS slot_active,
           (i ->> 'retained_bytes')::BIGINT AS retained_bytes, (i ->> 'safe_wal_size')::BIGINT AS safe_wal_size,
           (i ->> 'lag_bytes')::BIGINT AS lag_bytes, (i ->> 'oldest_xact_age_s')::DOUBLE AS oldest_xact_age_s,
           (i ->> 'invalidated_by_conflict') AS slot_conflict
    FROM (SELECT source_id, slots_as_of, unnest(from_json(coalesce(slots, '[]'), '["json"]')) AS i FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_status" WHERE true)
    WHERE (i ->> 'is_current')::BOOLEAN
  ), last_run AS (
    SELECT source_id, written_at, status FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_runs" WHERE true
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY written_at DESC) = 1
  ), fl AS (
    SELECT source_id,
           max(health) FILTER (WHERE flight = 'ingest') AS ingest_health,
           max(health) FILTER (WHERE flight = 'apply') AS apply_health,
           max(error) FILTER (WHERE flight = 'ingest') AS ingest_error,
           max(error) FILTER (WHERE flight = 'apply') AS apply_error,
           bool_or(urgent) FILTER (WHERE flight = 'ingest') AS ingest_urgent,
           bool_or(urgent) FILTER (WHERE flight = 'apply') AS apply_urgent,
           max(ok_at_s) FILTER (WHERE flight = 'ingest') AS ingest_ok_at_s,
           max(ok_at_s) FILTER (WHERE flight = 'apply') AS apply_ok_at_s
    FROM (
  WITH ingest AS (
    SELECT s.source_id, 'ingest' AS flight, s.status_as_of / 1e6 AS last_s,
           CASE WHEN s.last_failure_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (s.status_as_of IS NULL OR epoch(s.last_failure_at) > s.status_as_of / 1e6)
                THEN 'failed' ELSE s.status END AS status,
           CASE WHEN s.last_failure_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (s.status_as_of IS NULL OR epoch(s.last_failure_at) > s.status_as_of / 1e6)
                THEN s.last_failure_error ELSE s.error END AS error,
           CASE WHEN s.last_failure_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (s.status_as_of IS NULL OR epoch(s.last_failure_at) > s.status_as_of / 1e6)
                THEN s.last_failure_step ELSE s.step END AS step,
           c.runs, c.gap_s, 600 AS floor_s,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_runs" r WHERE r.source_id = s.source_id AND r.status = 'conflict'
              AND r.written_at > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS conflicts_24h,
           s.last_conflict_at, s.last_success_as_of / 1e6 AS ok_s
    FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_status" s
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_id, count(*) AS runs, quantile_cont(gap, 0.75) AS gap_s FROM (
    SELECT source_id, as_of / 1e6 - lag(as_of / 1e6) OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY as_of / 1e6) AS gap,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY as_of / 1e6 DESC) AS k
    FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_runs" WHERE as_of / 1e6 IS NOT NULL) WHERE k <= 20 GROUP BY source_id) c USING (source_id)
    WHERE true
  ), apply_rows AS (
    SELECT source_id, epoch(written_at) AS t, status, error, step,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id, status = 'busy' ORDER BY written_at DESC) AS k
    FROM "ops"."main"."apply_runs" WHERE table_name IS NULL
  ), apply AS (
    SELECT n.source_id, 'apply' AS flight, n.t AS last_s, n.status, n.error, n.step,
           CASE WHEN b.t > n.t THEN b.t END AS busy_s, c.runs, c.gap_s, 1800 AS floor_s,
           (SELECT max(o.t) FROM apply_rows o WHERE o.source_id = a.source_id AND o.status IN ('done')) AS ok_s
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source_id FROM apply_rows) a
    LEFT JOIN apply_rows n ON n.source_id = a.source_id AND n.status <> 'busy' AND n.k = 1
    LEFT JOIN apply_rows b ON b.source_id = a.source_id AND b.status = 'busy' AND b.k = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_id, count(*) AS runs, quantile_cont(gap, 0.75) AS gap_s FROM (
    SELECT source_id, epoch(written_at) - lag(epoch(written_at)) OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY epoch(written_at)) AS gap,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY epoch(written_at) DESC) AS k
    FROM "ops"."main"."apply_runs" WHERE epoch(written_at) IS NOT NULL AND table_name IS NULL AND status <> 'busy') WHERE k <= 20 GROUP BY source_id) c ON c.source_id = a.source_id
  ), backfill AS (
    SELECT source_id, 'backfill' AS flight, epoch(written_at) AS last_s, status, error, step,
           NULL::BIGINT AS runs, NULL::DOUBLE AS gap_s, NULL::INTEGER AS floor_s
    FROM "ops"."main"."backfill_runs" WHERE true
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY written_at DESC) = 1
  ), compaction AS (
    SELECT source_id, 'compaction' AS flight, run_as_of / 1e6 AS last_s, status, error, NULL AS step,
           NULL::BIGINT AS runs, NULL::DOUBLE AS gap_s, 93600 AS floor_s
    FROM "ops"."main"."compaction_status" WHERE true
  ), every AS (
    SELECT * FROM ingest UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT * FROM apply
    UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT * FROM backfill UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT * FROM compaction
  ), own AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN floor_s IS NULL THEN NULL
                   WHEN coalesce(runs, 0) < 5 THEN floor_s
                   ELSE greatest(floor_s, round(2 * gap_s)) END AS own_after_s,
           CASE WHEN flight NOT IN ('ingest', 'apply') THEN NULL
                WHEN coalesce(runs, 0) < 5 THEN 3600
                ELSE greatest(3600, round(6 * gap_s)) END AS own_urgent_s
    FROM every
  ), limits AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN flight = 'apply'
                   THEN greatest(own_after_s, max(CASE WHEN flight = 'ingest' THEN own_after_s END)
                                              OVER (PARTITION BY source_id))
                   ELSE own_after_s END AS after_s,
           CASE WHEN flight = 'apply'
                THEN greatest(own_urgent_s, max(CASE WHEN flight = 'ingest' THEN own_urgent_s END)
                                            OVER (PARTITION BY source_id))
                ELSE own_urgent_s END AS urgent_after_s
    FROM own
  )

         conflicts_24h, strftime((last_conflict_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC') AS last_conflict_at,

  FROM limits ORDER BY source_id, flight) GROUP BY source_id
  ), src AS (

         s.slot_name, s.wal_status, s.slot_active, s.retained_bytes, s.safe_wal_size, s.lag_bytes, s.oldest_xact_age_s,
         s.slots_as_of / 1e6 AS slot_at_s, s.slot_conflict,

WITH ingest AS (
    SELECT s.source_id, 'ingest' AS flight, s.status_as_of / 1e6 AS last_s,
           CASE WHEN s.last_failure_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (s.status_as_of IS NULL OR epoch(s.last_failure_at) > s.status_as_of / 1e6)
                THEN 'failed' ELSE s.status END AS status,
           CASE WHEN s.last_failure_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (s.status_as_of IS NULL OR epoch(s.last_failure_at) > s.status_as_of / 1e6)
                THEN s.last_failure_error ELSE s.error END AS error,
           CASE WHEN s.last_failure_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND (s.status_as_of IS NULL OR epoch(s.last_failure_at) > s.status_as_of / 1e6)
                THEN s.last_failure_step ELSE s.step END AS step,
           c.runs, c.gap_s, 600 AS floor_s,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_runs" r WHERE r.source_id = s.source_id AND r.status = 'conflict'
              AND r.written_at > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS conflicts_24h,
           s.last_conflict_at, s.last_success_as_of / 1e6 AS ok_s
    FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_status" s

WITH r AS (
    SELECT source_id, 'ingest' AS writer, written_at, tls_mode, tls_ca, tls_in_use FROM "ops"."main"."ingest_runs"
    WHERE written_at > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT source_id, 'backfill', written_at, tls_mode, tls_ca, tls_in_use FROM "ops"."main"."backfill_runs"
    WHERE written_at > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    UNION ALL
    SELECT source_id, 'action ' || action, written_at, tls_mode, tls_ca, tls_in_use FROM "ops"."main"."audit"
    WHERE written_at > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      AND action IN ('add', 'remove', 'recover-slot', 'skip-to-lsn', 'delete-source')
      AND (tls_mode IS NOT NULL OR tls_in_use IS NOT NULL)
  ), req AS (
    SELECT source_id, writer, tls_mode, tls_ca, written_at AS req_at FROM r
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id, writer ORDER BY written_at DESC) = 1
  ), neg AS (
    SELECT source_id, writer, tls_mode AS neg_mode, tls_in_use, written_at AS neg_at FROM r
    WHERE tls_in_use IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id, writer ORDER BY written_at DESC) = 1
  ), w AS (
    SELECT req.source_id, req.writer, req.tls_ca, req.req_at, neg.neg_at,
           CASE WHEN neg.tls_in_use = false THEN 'PLAINTEXT'
                WHEN req.tls_mode = 'verify-full' AND neg.tls_in_use AND neg.neg_mode = 'verify-full'
                  THEN 'verify-full'
                WHEN req.tls_mode = 'verify-full' THEN 'not yet connected'
                WHEN neg.tls_in_use THEN 'encrypted, not verified'
                WHEN req.tls_mode IS NOT NULL THEN 'requested only'
                ELSE 'unknown' END AS state
    FROM req LEFT JOIN neg USING (source_id, writer)
  ), ranked AS (
    SELECT *, CASE state WHEN 'PLAINTEXT' THEN 1 WHEN 'encrypted, not verified' THEN 2
  WHEN 'requested only' THEN 3 WHEN 'not yet connected' THEN 4 WHEN 'verify-full' THEN 4 END AS rank,
           state || CASE WHEN state = 'verify-full' AND tls_ca IS NOT NULL THEN ' (' || tls_ca || ')' ELSE '' END
             AS label,
           -- the time of the row the state rests on: the negotiated one, except for a request
           -- not yet seen connecting, whose own row is the evidence
           epoch(CASE WHEN state IN ('not yet connected', 'requested only', 'unknown') THEN req_at ELSE neg_at END)::VARCHAR AS as_of
    FROM w
  )
  SELECT source_id,
         coalesce(first(label ORDER BY rank, CASE state WHEN 'verify-full' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, writer) FILTER (WHERE rank IS NOT NULL), 'unknown') AS tls,
         coalesce(min(rank) FILTER (WHERE rank IS NOT NULL), 4) < 4 AS warn,
         -- each writer's time as @<epoch seconds>@: the browser formats it (model.ts tlsText)
         string_agg(writer || ' ' || label || ' (as of @' || coalesce(as_of, '') || '@)', '; '
                    ORDER BY coalesce(rank, 5), CASE state WHEN 'verify-full' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, writer)
           AS breakdown
  FROM ranked GROUP BY source_id ORDER BY source_id
